title: ContextSafe review event 1.0
$comment: The pre-signature shape of the contextsafe-review-v1.schema.json listed in docs/04-ARCHITECTURE.md section 8 (B-032). One declared, unverified review decision about one outcome of one receipt. Every field is a closed value, a hash, or a bounded token under the ADR 0006 provenance grammars: there is no free-text field, by construction, so a note or a sentence of clinical judgement has no field to be written into; a name-shaped token that fits a grammar is not refused by the shape, only by the canary and direct-identifier scans, and a grammar cannot see ordinary letters. #/$defs/log_record is the shape of one line of the append-only review log. The decision, severity, role, and rationale vocabularies are reference-only and ungoverned: they are not the approved severity rubric (B-010) or the reviewer registry (B-035), and no clinical, community, legal, or security review of them has happened.
x-contextsafe-semantic-constraints: a declared signer authorizes nothing: signature_status is the constant not_verified on the event and on every signer, and a later signing layer must publish a new contract version rather than relabel these documents

an accepted_residual_risk event carries exactly two signers, one customer_clinical_owner and one contextsafe_clinical_safety_chair, from distinct organization_id values; neither substitutes for the other, and without both the event is refused
severity is required by confirmed, severity_changed (and must differ from the finding's current severity) and accepted_residual_risk (and must equal it); it is forbidden on every other decision
owner is required by owner_assigned and forbidden on every other decision

receipt.payload_sha256 and receipt.rule_set_sha256 must equal the receipt document's payload_sha256 and payload.hashes.rule_set_sha256, and the receipt's payload_sha256 must re-hash; outcome must name a fail, indeterminate, or blocked result in that receipt
whether the decision is legal for the finding's current disposition is decided by the runtime transition table against the log's prior state, not by this schema
organization_id and external_reference carry no configured PHI canary; a canary is ordinary letters and no grammar can exclude one, so this is checked by content inspection at parse time
this event binds nothing into any receipt; the receipt contract is unchanged

severity.$comment: Reference-only labels after docs/03-SERVICE-DESIGN.md section 8. Not the approved rubric.

rationale_code.$comment: A closed vocabulary standing where a rationale sentence would otherwise be.

external_reference.$comment: An optional pointer to a record held outside the tool, under the ADR 0006 provenance-label grammar: letter-initial, every separated segment begins with a letter, no run of four or more digits, no colon, no slash, no host label. A ticket key can be written here; a date, a record number, a URL, and an email address cannot.

allOf.$comment: letter-initial, and neither a colon nor a slash is in the alphabet, so no URL scheme can be written
no run of four or more digits: makes a date, a social security number, a telephone number and a record number unwritable
every separated segment begins with a letter, so no segment is a bare number
no host label: the one URL shape the alphabet above still admits

outcome_key.$comment: The outcome the event binds to; the identity of a finding in the log. The concept enum is the five Gender Harmony concepts kept distinct everywhere else, and an event cannot relabel one as another.

owner.$comment: A role from a closed set plus the SHA-256 of an opaque handle held outside the tool. A name is not writable here: the token is sixty-four hexadecimal characters and nothing else.

declared_signer.$comment: A declared, unverified signer: a role from a closed set and an organization label under the ADR 0006 system-label grammar. No key, no name, no signature bytes. A declared signer authorizes nothing.

allOf.$comment: the upper-case alphabet system_id already publishes; a host label needs a lower-case letter and a dot, so it cannot be written here at all
no run of four or more digits
every separated segment begins with a letter

log_record.$comment: One line of the append-only review log: canonical JSON, one record per line. sequence is the zero-based line index, previous_record_sha256 is the SHA-256 of the canonical JSON of the record before it (sixty-four zeros for the first), and event_sha256 is the SHA-256 of the canonical JSON of event. The runtime re-derives all three on every read and refuses a log where any line does not re-hash, is not byte-exact canonical JSON, or does not replay.
